label: prf:lr-tensor-character-bridge
title: Proof of lr tensor character bridge
html: Setting I = \mathbf{1} in Hecke branching trace decomposition collapses the operator-valued coefficient A^\lambda_{\mu,\nu}(\mathbf{1}) to the identity on V_\mu \otimes V_\nu, so the trace splits across the tensor factors and the scalar prefactor reduces to the two-factor LR coefficient c^\lambda_{\mu,\nu}. Iterating k-1 times across the parabolic chain stacks the LR coefficients into the iterated form c^\nu_{\lambda_1, \ldots, \lambda_k}. ∎
